headlines.title: 中信建投：五部门“组合拳”出台 房地产基础性制度重构
headlines.summary: 中信建投研报表示，住建部、自然资源部、金融监管总局、央行、证监会五部门同步发力，出台三份文件及5份信贷配套文件，涵盖商品住房销售、信贷、融资、资本市场支持等全链条，房地产基础制度迎来重大调整。短期看，现房销售及预售门槛提升将导致新房可售货源阶段性收缩，房企资金阶段性承压；但中长期看，“所见即所得”、资金闭环及项目制融资将从根本上规避烂尾风险，核心城市成交有望在政策催化与制度红利双重作用下率先企稳。（人民财讯）

headlines.title_en: CSC Financial: Five-Department 'Combined Measures' Unveiled, Fundamental Real Estate System Restructured
headlines.summary_en: CSC Research report says five departments—MOHURD, Ministry of Natural Resources, NFRA, PBOC, and CSRC—jointly issued three documents and five credit supporting documents, covering the full chain of commercial housing sales, credit, financing, and capital market support, marking major adjustments to the real estate foundational system. In the short term, higher presale thresholds and a shift toward cash sales will cause a phased contraction in new home supply and pressure developers' cash flow; but over the medium to long term, 'see-what-you-get', closed capital loops, and project-based financing will fundamentally eliminate the risk of unfinished projects, with core-city transactions expected to stabilize first amid policy catalysts and institutional dividends. (People's Financial News)

headlines.title: 中金公司：沃什表态转鹰 市场认可以短期鹰派换取长期稳定
headlines.summary: 中金公司研报表示，北京时间8月28日晚，美联储主席沃什在Jackson Hole全球央行年会上发表主旨演讲。整体看，沃什表态转鹰，再次强调以PCE衡量的2%通胀目标，并重申美联储维护价格稳定的职责。市场也对此报以鹰派反应，2年利率跳升超过10bp，美元大涨，黄金大跌3%，CME期货对9月加息的预期从35%跳升至58%。不过鹰派的反应却不是恐慌式的波动，美股波动有限，10年美债利率仅走高4bp，30年美债反而回落，表明市场认可以短期的鹰派换取长期的稳定。

headlines.title_en: CICC: Waller Turns Hawkish, Market Embraces Short-Term Hawkishness for Long-Term Stability
headlines.summary_en: CICC Research report says on the evening of August 28 Beijing time, Fed Chair Warsh delivered a keynote speech at the Jackson Hole global central bank symposium. Overall, Warsh turned hawkish, reiterating the 2% PCE inflation target and affirming the Fed's price stability mandate. Markets reacted hawkishly, with the two-year yield jumping over 10 bps, the dollar surging, gold falling 3%, and CME futures pricing a September hike probability rising from 35% to 58%. However, the hawkish reaction was not panic-driven: US equities were little changed, the 10-year Treasury yield rose only 4 bps, and the 30-year yield actually fell, showing markets accept short-term hawkishness for long-term stability.

headlines.title: 武契奇：中企承建快速路通车助推塞尔维亚经济发展
headlines.summary: 当地时间30日上午，塞尔维亚“多瑙走廊”快速路项目举行通车仪式。塞尔维亚总统武契奇、第一副总理兼财政部长马利，建设、交通和基础设施部部长索夫罗尼耶维奇，以及中国驻塞尔维亚使馆临时代办张喆等出席活动。当日，武契奇乘车体验了“多瑙走廊”快速路，并在随后致辞中高度评价项目对塞尔维亚发展的重要意义。他说，“多瑙走廊”快速路项目对于实现塞尔维亚国家利益、推动国内旅游业发展以及促进东部地区经济增长发挥着重要作用。（新华社）

headlines.title_en: Vucic: Chinese-Built Expressway Opening Boosts Serbian Economy
headlines.summary_en: On the morning of the 30th local time, a ceremony marked the opening of Serbia's 'Danube Corridor' expressway project. Serbian President Vucic, First Deputy Prime Minister and Finance Minister Mali, Minister of Construction, Transport and Infrastructure Sofronijevic, and Chinese Charge d'Affaires ad interim Zhang Zhe attended. That day, Vucic rode the expressway and praised its importance to Serbia's development, saying the project plays a key role in realizing Serbia's national interests, boosting domestic tourism, and driving eastern region economic growth. (Xinhua)

headlines.title: “新美联储通讯社”：沃什目前已经陷入两难的局面，是否加息几乎完全押注在通胀数据上
headlines.summary: 素有“新美联储通讯社 ”之称的名记Nick Timiraos表示，美联储此前的默认立场是按兵不动，除非数据支持加息。但在沃什发表杰克逊霍尔演讲之后，数位前央行官员认为他已经扭转了这一逻辑：现在数据必须给出美联储下个月不采取行动的充分理由。 如果数据和事态发展未能提供这样的理由，那么摆在美联储面前的将是一个两难抉择：要么维持利率不变，但这会重新引发7月债券市场的那轮恐慌；要么加息，但这又与任命沃什的那位总统的意愿背道而驰——而中期选举就在数周之后。

headlines.title_en: 'New Fed Whisperer': Waller Now in a Dilemma, Rate Hike Decision Nearly Fully Pinned on Inflation Data
headlines.summary_en: Nick Timiraos, the journalist known as the 'new Fed whisperer', said the Fed's previous default stance was to hold steady unless data supported a hike. But after Warsh's Jackson Hole speech, several former central bank officials believe he has flipped that logic: now data must provide sufficient reason for the Fed not to act next month. If data and developments fail to offer such reason, the Fed faces a dilemma: hold rates steady, risking a repeat of July's bond market panic, or hike, contradicting the wishes of the president who appointed Warsh—with midterm elections just weeks away.

headlines.title_en: Brokerages: Earnings beat expectations solidify fundamentals, A-share market rebound window may be approaching
headlines.summary_en: Over the past week, the A-share market showed a decline-then-rise trend, with sentiment warming. Broker strategy outlook reports say interim report disclosures are largely complete, corporate earnings continue to recover, and better-than-expected earnings growth supports the A-share trend from a fundamental standpoint. Looking to September, the market bottoming process is in its latter half, the window for domestic incremental policy is opening, and rebound momentum is building. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: 境外业务收入和回报大幅增长，券商业绩“第三极” 悄然成型
headlines.summary: 随着半年报陆续披露，一个信号越来越清晰——继经纪、自营之后，境外业务已成为头部券商业绩增长的“第三极”。从已披露的数据看，中信证券、中金公司、华泰证券等头部机构的境外平台收入、利润及资产规模均实现快速增长，跨境投行、交易及机构服务等业务加速拓展。业内人士认为，随着中国企业“走出去”和国际资本“引进来”需求持续增长，中资券商国际业务正由牌照和网点布局的竞争，转向资本实力、全球网络与综合服务能力的竞争。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: Overseas business revenue and returns surge, brokerage 'third pole' quietly takes shape
headlines.summary_en: As interim reports roll out, a signal is becoming clearer—following brokerage and proprietary trading, overseas business has become the 'third pole' of growth for top brokerages. From disclosed data, overseas platforms of leading institutions like CITIC Securities, CICC, and Huatai Securities posted rapid growth in revenue, profits, and asset scale, with cross-border investment banking, trading, and institutional services expanding swiftly. Industry insiders believe that as demand grows for Chinese enterprises going global and international capital coming in, Chinese brokers' international business is shifting from competition over licenses and branch networks to competition over capital strength, global networks, and comprehensive service capabilities. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.summary_en: Global online fashion and lifestyle company Shein recently disclosed its global offering announcement, with Boyu Capital, Tencent, Greenwoods, Taikang Life, and other institutions appearing on the cornerstone investor list. This diverse, large-scale cornerstone list focused on new-economy leaders is a vivid snapshot of the 2026 Hong Kong IPO cornerstone market. As of August 30, 85 IPO companies have introduced cornerstone investors this year, with a total of 962 investments, up 269% year-on-year. Insurance funds, public funds, foreign asset managers, sovereign funds, and industrial capital frequently appear on IPO cornerstone lists, with funds focusing on hard tech, biotech, and consumer sectors. (China Securities Journal)

headlines.title_en: Shanghai-Listed Companies' Half-Year Non-GAAP Net Profit Growth Hits Four-Year High
headlines.summary_en: On the evening of August 30, Shanghai-listed companies' 2026 interim reports were fully disclosed. Data show Shanghai-listed companies posted growth in both revenue and net profit, showing a steady development trend with new momentum and improved structure. In H1 2026, 2,318 Shanghai-listed companies generated total revenue of 26.22 trillion yuan, up 6.3% year-on-year; net profit reached 2.82 trillion yuan, up 17.6%; and non-GAAP net profit hit 2.69 trillion yuan, up 17.2%, the fastest growth since 2022. Nearly 80% of companies were profitable, with 924 seeing net profit growth, 339 up over 50%, and 142 turning profitable from losses. Blue-chip companies continued to act as ballast: Shanghai 180 firms posted revenue of 17.87 trillion yuan and net profit of 2.36 trillion yuan, up 6.9% and 14% year-on-year, respectively...

headlines.title: 业绩修复“温差”明显，息差企稳信号清晰
headlines.summary: 42家A股上市银行半年报披露收官。从整体表现来看，上市银行盈利进一步修复，但回暖趋势下的“温差”比较明显。大行改善，股份行承压，城商行突围，农商行企稳，各梯队银行演绎迥然不同的修复节奏。与此同时，多家上市银行净息差实现同比回升，企稳信号清晰。在息差低位运行背景下，非息收入成为观察银行经营韧性的另一扇窗口。

headlines.title_en: Clear Divergence in Earnings Recovery, Signals of Stabilizing Net Interest Margins Emerge
headlines.summary_en: Disclosure of interim reports from 42 A-share listed banks has concluded. Overall, listed banks saw further earnings recovery, but the divergence within the warming trend is clear. Big banks are improving, joint-stock banks are under pressure, city commercial banks are breaking through, and rural commercial banks are stabilizing, with each tier showing distinctly different recovery paces. Meanwhile, several listed banks saw year-on-year net interest margin recovery, with clear stabilization signals. Amid low NIMs, non-interest income has become another key window into bank operational resilience.

headlines.title: 塞尔维亚：欧洲首座人形机器人量产基地正式投产，年产最高可达2万台
headlines.summary: 8月29日，塞尔维亚首座机器人工厂在该国西部城市沙巴茨正式投产。这座由中塞两国联合建设的工厂，也是欧洲首座人形机器人量产基地。据介绍，这座机器人工厂一期投资额为2000万欧元，占地约3000平方米，主要开展人形机器人和机器狗的组装、运动及视觉系统校准和性能测试。工厂生产的人形机器人未来将首先应用于工业生产，并逐步拓展至教育、公共服务等领域。按照规划，项目后续还将在塞尔维亚建设机器人产业园，计划总投资额约2亿欧元，约合15.6亿元人民币。项目全部建成后，人形机器人和机器狗的年产能预计最高可达2万台，产品将面向欧洲及全球市场。（央视财经）

headlines.title_en: Serbia: Europe's first humanoid robot mass production base officially operational, with annual capacity of up to 20,000 units
headlines.summary_en: On August 29, Serbia's first robot factory officially began production in the western city of Sabac. Jointly built by China and Serbia, it is also Europe's first mass-production base for humanoid robots. The factory's first-phase investment is 20 million euros, covering about 3,000 square meters, mainly handling assembly of humanoid robots and robot dogs, motion and vision system calibration, and performance testing. Humanoid robots produced there will first be used in industrial production, later expanding to education and public services. According to plans, the project will subsequently build a robotics industrial park in Serbia, with a total planned investment of about 200 million euros, roughly 1.56 billion yuan. Once fully complete, annual capacity for humanoid robots and robot dogs is expected to reach up to 20,000 units, targeting European and global markets. (CCTV Finance)

headlines.title_en: CSC Financial: Coping with Volatile Markets via 'Rebalancing'
headlines.summary_en: Jin10 Data August 31: CSC Research points out that A-share sentiment is warming, lifted by overseas rebounds, while domestic capital flows remain in a rebalancing process, suggesting a slightly steady repair pace, with the bottom building and momentum gathering. Overseas, the Fed is cautious but hawkish, reiterating the 2% inflation target, which short-term pressures global risk assets, but its clear stance, if it stabilizes long-end rates and flattens the curve, would help ease tail risks of overtightened financial conditions. Nvidia's earnings and guidance beat expectations, confirming resilience in AI capex and computing demand, providing medium-to-long-term fundamental support for the tech sector. Allocation-wise, use 'rebalancing' to improve portfolio adaptability to range-bound markets: retain positions in sectors with confirmed improving fundamentals, while adding defensive base holdings and laggard catch-up plays, seeking turning points where 'cheap valuations + low institutional positioning + improving fundamentals' converge. Key sectors to watch...
